newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell withdraws from LME floor.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell withdraws from LME floor.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) said on Wednesday that it is to relinquish its London Metal Exchange (LME) membership.

"As part of the continuing integration and enhancement of the commodity operations within Deutsche Morgan Grenfell we have decided to re-focus our LME operations and relinquish our ring membership," DMG said in a release.
DMG said that it remained firmly committed to the base metals business, and that its interests would be served by being an LME Associate Broker Clearing Member.
A DMG spokesman said that the company would be adopting its new status with immediate effect. It would not be manning the floor this afternoon.
Also, some staff would be leaving the company today, he said.
